title: Register the Smart Guitar geometry authority package in SPRINTS.md

diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The current Smart Guitar design rulings exist only in session notes. docs/SPRINTS_MAINTENANCE.md Rule 6 forbids chat-only notes as the system of record, which is how the 4.5 deg op20_status survived three supersessions unnoticed. No other SPRINTS entry carries body height, the 12th-fret attachment, the neck-angle band or the neck-pocket dispositions.
diff_articulation.what_changed: Appends one DATA INTEGRITY sprint section before ## COMPLETED. It records the owner's 2026-09-20 geometry package with a per-quantity disposition table (521.8 current working authority / 528.1 superseded / 438.15 reference only), the design-ruling-to-CAM authority chain, the provisional body-height-to-body_length_mm equivalence, the quantities derived from 528.1 that must be recomputed before reuse, and the contradictions re-read on main. No record file, schema or calculator is amended.

intent: Give the geometry reconciliation a system-of-record starting point that preserves the authority distinctions exactly, without prematurely claiming CAD verification.
